description: Get metadata for a Spanish INE time series by its series_code — name, decimals, periodicity (monthly/quarterly/annual), parent operation, and publication. Data: servicios.ine.es (INE Tempus3 API), no auth required.

series_code.description: INE series code (e.g. "IPC206449" for the national CPI monthly change series).

name: ine.series.metadata

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: INE Series Metadata
